text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm... this is so good!
It's piping hot and delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come on, why don't you have some too?
While it's still piping hot!
One day, after the hectic racing schedule had settled down—we visited a hot spring town using the hot spring trip ticket Daring Heart had won in a lottery earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait!
I'll take a video instead.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Alright, over to you for the food review♪
choice_data_list: Wait, what...!? That's asking for the impossible...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: “I won't hear any complaints! Come on! First, take a bite... here you go!”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're saying the exact same thing as me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Geez... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, letting your guard down, are we?
No way, I'm keeping the camera rolling.
I'm making an "Onsen Vlog," after all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, next time I want to take photos
somewhere with a traditional Japanese vibe!
Let's go scout some locations!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, there aren't many people around right now! This is our chance!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Then, how about this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Aren't you just
saying whatever comes to mind?
choice_data_list: It's the truth, so there's no other way to put it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Really?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then that's fine!
Hey, let's take a photo together next!
And so, we enjoyed the hot spring town together with Daring Heart—
In the bath...
—It was a wonderful bath that soaked deep into my body, weary from walking around all day...
choice_data_list: (Where is Heart... In her room, maybe?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "I was looking back through the videos and photos we took today. Then some old ones popped up too... look."

text_block_list.name: Video Audio
text_block_list.text:
"...W-Whaaat?!
O-Oh my god!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right!
It's a gift unboxing video.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You really gave it your all
with those reactions, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No!
It's a precious memory, after all.

"Come to think of it... around Christmas,
it felt like Daring Heart suddenly got really into filming."
choice_data_list: Why do you want to take pictures so badly?
Why do you want to take pictures so badly?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You know, Craft
really loves taking photos.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The emotion of meeting someone, the racing heart...
She says she wants to preserve those feelings forever."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I really think having records like that
will give you a lot of strength when you look back on them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Thinking about the future, I felt that I wanted something to help give me strength too.
choice_data_list: ...Could my videos be of help too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Of course.

I prop my smartphone up on the desk, adjusting the angle so both of us are in frame.
With that done, I turn to face her—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: I am so proud of you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
…………
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I promise.
I will... always be your pride.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even without making a video...
you'll keep telling me things like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then... could you give me
a memory from a different angle?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Will you tell me, "Heart, you're the cutest ever!"?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Will you tell me, "Heart, you're the cutest ever!"?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because it will help me so, so much!
...Please!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, total monotone!
That's so mean!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's fine!
You're just feeling shy, aren't you? Fufu♪”

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Daring Heart...
